name: Canonical Port Fixed Trade Modes
description: Class 1 SBB ORE mode remains fixed as stock changes and trade attempts run

tests.name: Rig: Put class 1 port and player in sector two

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET type = 1, sector_id = 2 WHERE port_id = 2

tests.name: Rig: Configure SBB to sell ORE and stock it at zero

data.sql: DELETE FROM port_trade WHERE port_id = 2 AND commodity = 'ORE'

tests.name: Rig: Seed fixed SBB ORE sell mode

data.sql: INSERT INTO port_trade (port_id, commodity, mode, maxproduct) VALUES (2, 'ORE', 'sell', 5000)

tests.name: Rig: Set SBB ORE inventory to zero

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity, price, last_updated_ts) VALUES ('port', 2, 'ORE', 0, 100, 0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 0

tests.name: Rig: Move player and ship into SBB sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 2 WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id}

tests.name: Rig: Move player ship into SBB sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 2 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{port_mode_player_player_id})

tests.name: SBB does not buy ORE from player when stock is zero
Rig: Add ORE stock without changing SBB mode

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code, quantity, price, last_updated_ts) VALUES ('port', 2, 'ORE', 100, 100, 0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id, commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity = 100

tests.name: SBB still does not buy ORE from player after stock changes
SBB still sells ORE from its inventory
Port transaction did not rewrite canonical SBB mode

data.sql: SELECT mode FROM port_trade WHERE port_id = 2 AND commodity = 'ORE'
